Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi has stressed the importance of unity and solidarity across the Muslim world, as well as the continuation of domestic cohesion, during the “Narrative of Mercy” event held to mark the 1,500th anniversary of the birth of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The event was held on Saturday evening (August 29, 2026), at Tehran’s Vahdat Hall, featuring a performance of the “Soul of the Worlds” suite symphony. It was attended by Culture and Islamic Guidance Minister Seyed Abbas Salehi, Foreign Minister Araghchi, a number of cultural, artistic and cinema figures, and some foreign ambassadors accredited to Iran. Congratulating Muslims on the birth[08/31/2026 02:35 ب.ظ ] Hamid Reza Babaee: Araghchi at “Narrative of Mercy” event: National unity and cohesion are strongest bulwarks for safeguarding independence, dignity Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi has stressed the importance of unity and solidarity across the Muslim world, as well as the continuation of domestic cohesion, during the “Narrative of Mercy” event held to mark the 1,500th anniversary of the birth of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The event was held on Saturday evening (August 29, 2026), at Tehran’s Vahdat Hall, featuring a performance of the “Soul of the Worlds” suite symphony. It was attended by Culture and Islamic Guidance Minister Seyed Abbas Salehi, Foreign Minister Araghchi, a number of cultural, artistic and cinema figures, and some foreign ambassadors accredited to Iran. Congratulating Muslims on the birth anniversary of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), the foreign minister said the most important mission of the Prophet was to promote moral virtues, brotherhood, and friendship among Muslims. Referring to the constant emphasis by Imam Khomeini and the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution on unity in the Muslim world, Araghchi said, “The message of Imam Khomeini, the lessons taught by our martyred Leader, and the ideal of unity in the Muslim world are at the forefront of the Islamic Republic of Iran’s foreign policy, and we will pursue this unity under all circumstances.” Referring to the high standing of the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution in the history of Islam and Iran, Araghchi added, “I have made this statement on various occasions and I repeat it once again: After 70 years of striving in the path of God, he truly deserved the exalted rank of martyrdom. However, this in no way means that we will forget this great crime, we will always remain committed to avenging the blood of our martyred leader.” Referring to his visit to an exhibition of paintings by prominent Iranian artists on the subject of the Minab School, the foreign minister said, “Yesterday, I had the opportunity to visit this exhibition. These works clearly show how the Iranian people stood their ground, how they emerged victorious, and how they thwarted the enemy’s malicious objectives.” Araghchi also referred to the Iranian people’s resistance during the 40-day war, saying, “The Iranian people accomplished a great feat during these 40 days. They stood for 40 days against what appeared to be the world’s largest army, while other armies and countries had also come to support, back and assist it. This steadfastness was an important lesson for the entire world.” “The Iranian people demonstrated their power, resilience and tenacity in this war and showed that if we all stand united, we can withstand all pressures,” he added. The foreign minister stressed, “The 40-day war was a proud period of national unity and cohesion, and we must safeguard this valuable achievement.”

Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi attended an interactive session with participants of the 40th International Islamic Unity Conference, held in the presence of Hojjatoleslam Hamid Shahriari, Secretary General of the World Forum for Proximity of Islamic Schools of Thought, as well as scholars and thinkers from Iran and other countries. Addressing regional and international developments, Araghchi described the issue of Palestine as the most important concern of the Muslim world and stressed the need to strengthen Islamic unity to thwart the conspiracies of the Israeli regime and its main supporter, the United States. “Our approach to the Muslim world is based on strengthening unity among the Islamic Ummah,” the Iranian foreign minister said. “This approach is the legacy of Imam Khomeini and our martyred leader, and today, under the guidance of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, we are all determined to continue along the same path.” Describing developments in the region over the past two years, including the US-Israeli wars imposed on Iran, Araghchi said the martyrdom of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution after 70 years of struggle for Iran’s independence and dignity had established a new starting point and foundation for continuing the path of seeking justice and exercising strength. “Undoubtedly, avenging the blood of our martyred leader, in continuation of the movement of Karbala, will remain a lasting demand of the Iranian nation and all Muslims and freedom-seekers around the world,” he said. Araghchi said the Islamic Republic of Iran, which he described as a “blessed tree,” had grown into a strong and mighty tree thanks to the blood of martyrs, the steadfastness of the discerning Iranian people and the courage of the country’s powerful armed forces, adding that its strength and dignity would continue to increase. Referring to the consequences of the US-Israeli military aggression for the region, the foreign minister said one of the most important outcomes of the war was that everyone realized the US military presence in regional countries does not provide security for them. “The only objective of the United States in the region is to support the illegitimate and expansionist ambitions of the genocidal Zionist regime,” he said. Araghchi said this growing understanding, which amounts to losing hope in the United States, could pave the way for the emergence of endogenous security based on trust and cooperation among regional countries. He also highlighted the Islamic Republic’s commitment to the interests of the Islamic Ummah, particularly the Resistance Front, saying Iran had spared no effort at any stage to help promote unity in the Muslim world in confronting the Israeli regime’s occupation, ending the genocide against Palestinians, and putting an end to Israel’s aggression and occupation of Lebanon. The foreign minister stressed that Iran firmly believes security and stability in West Asia require an end to the Israeli regime’s impunity and the realization of the Palestinian people’s right to self-determination, with Al-Quds as its capital. He added that the Islamic Republic’s proposed plan in this regard was clear. Araghchi described strengthening national self-confidence and demonstrating the value and importance of independence and self-reliance as among the most important legacies of the Islamic Revolution. He said these factors had contributed to advancing a diplomacy based on dignity, emphasizing that Iran’s diplomatic apparatus would continue working with full force to safeguard the country’s national interests based on the three principles of “dignity, wisdom and expediency,” and would under no circumstances show leniency toward excessive demands or bullying. During the session, Araghchi thanked Muslim scholars and thinkers from various countries for attending the International Islamic Unity Conference and responded to questions and proposals raised by some participants.He also stressed Iran’s principled approach to developing good relations with all Islamic countries, particularly neighboring states, saying Tehran sought the best possible relations with its neighbors in all fields, including economic and scientific cooperation. He said strengthening relations among Muslim countries was essential to enhancing the position of the Muslim world globally and improving the situation of Muslims in all parts of the world. “I believe that God has destined the path of unity and solidarity for Islamic countries,” Araghchi said, adding that care must be taken to ensure that differences do not allow enemies to exploit them to sow division among the Islamic Ummah. At the end of the meeting, the foreign minister thanked Hamid Shahriari and the World Forum for Proximity of Islamic Schools of Thought for organizing the session and for their efforts to strengthen Islamic unity. Shahriari, for his part, thanked the Foreign Ministry for its cooperation in organizing the 40th Islamic Unity Conference, as well as the foreign minister and Iran’s diplomatic apparatus for their continued efforts to promote rapprochement and unity across the Muslim world.

In continuation of its hostile and unlawful policies against Iran, the US government on Monday, August 24, 2026, unveiled a new wave of economic terrorism against Iran under the title of “Economic Exclusion Operation,” which constitutes US state terrorism against Iran and the world. The United States’ abuse of the dollar as a tool to intimidate other countries and force them to comply with its interventionist policies, which violate international law, in relation to Iran constitutes a violation of the national sovereignty and the right to self-determination of all United Nations Member States. US sanctions against Iran, by virtue of both their nature and their consequences, constitute a flagrant violation of the UN Charter. These sanctions violate the principle of “non-intervention in the internal affairs of States” and the principle of “the prohibition of any obstruction to cooperation among States,” as emphasized, inter alia, in paragraph 2(k) of the “Declaration on the Inadmissibility of Intervention and Interference in the Internal Affairs of States” (Resolution 36/103 of December 9, 1981) and the “Declaration on Principles of International Law concerning Friendly Relations and Cooperation among States” (General Assembly Resolution 2625 of October 24, 1970). The declaration of economic war against Iran is a continuation of the war of aggression that the United States and the Israeli regime have waged against Iran over the past year and a half under false and baseless pretexts, putting regional and international peace and security at risk. All of these actions constitute violations of international law. Unfortunately, the indifference and appeasement of the United Nations system and its Member States toward the flagrant violations of international law by the United States and the Israeli regime have led to the emergence of an extremely dangerous pattern of lawlessness and the commission of the most serious international crimes by them, the consequences of which have placed the entirety of human civilization under an unprecedented threat. The “Economic Exclusion Operation” in itself demonstrates the criminal intent of its planners and implementers to inflict pain and suffering on the Iranian people and deprive Iranian citizens of their fundamental human rights and therefore constitutes an international crime and a crime against humanity. This policy constitutes an explicit violation of the fundamental human rights norms enshrined in the human rights declarations and covenants, and is contrary to paragraph 2 of Article 1 of the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights. US sanctions also constitute a continuing violation of the October 3, 2018 order of the International Court of Justice, which obliges the United States to remove all obstacles and restrictions on the free flow of trade, including food and agricultural products, medicines and medical devices, equipment and services essential for civil aviation safety, and related funds. The new US sanctions policy has created a new situation, and it is necessary for the international community, including the organs of the United Nations, to take the necessary measures to safeguard the rule of law and the principles of the UN Charter. US economic sanctions against Iran, regardless of their name or designation, are entirely unlawful and unjustified measures that violate the UN Charter, international humanitarian law and human rights. Accordingly, all States are obliged to refrain from implementing such sanctions. All States are also obliged to refrain from recognizing or endorsing situations or effects arising from these unlawful measures. Participation in the implementation of US unilateral sanctions against Iran amounts to complicity in imposing the unlawful will of one State upon sovereign States and disrupting their legitimate economic and trade relations.This would constitute participation in undermining the most important principle of the UN Charter, namely, “respect for the sovereign equality” of States. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, while condemning US economic terrorism, reaffirms the Iranian nation’s determination to use all available capacities to defend the homeland against the military, economic and hybrid warfare waged by the US-Israeli side. There is no doubt that the Iranian people, united and resolute, drawing on their great civilizational heritage and the inspiring teachings of their religious and national traditions, and benefiting from the profound experiences of recent decades, will thwart the malign actions of their enemies and continue to strengthen the power and authority of our homeland day by day.

item.content:encoded:

Qatar’s Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, who has traveled to Tehran for talks with senior Iranian officials on bilateral relations and regional developments, met and held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi on Thursday afternoon. Welcoming the continued efforts by regional countries and Iran’s neighbors to help reduce tensions, Araghchi said the current situation is solely the result of U.S. and Israeli military aggression, as well as the continued illegal and interventionist actions by the United States, particularly its maritime blockade and economic terrorism against Iran. Referring to Iran’s principled position on the need to strengthen trust among regional countries in order to establish indigenous regional security mechanisms independent of interference by external actors, Araghchi noted that achieving this goal requires all regional countries to adhere to the principle of good neighborliness and prevent the United States from using their territories and facilities to prepare for and carry out acts of aggression, as well as economic warfare against Iran. Referring to the insecurity imposed on the Strait of Hormuz as a result of the U.S.-Israeli military aggression against Iran—which, regrettably, was accompanied and facilitated by some regional countries—Araghchi stressed that it is impossible to speak of returning to the situation that existed before May 31, 2026, without taking into account the realities on the ground as well as the crimes committed against Iran and the damage inflicted on the country. Araghchi emphasized that Iran had been implementing its commitments under the War Termination Memorandum in good faith, including Clause 5, but that the United States disrupted the implementation process by reneging on its commitments. He added that Washington had recently revealed its hostility and animosity toward the Iranian people more clearly than ever by announcing a new wave of economic terrorism. Araghchi stressed that the Islamic Republic of Iran is resolute and steadfast in pursuing its national interests and security and will use all available capacities to defend its national sovereignty and interests. For his part, Qatar’s prime minister and foreign minister, referring to his country’s principled position on safeguarding regional security and stability, stressed the importance of continuing consultations to reduce tensions and insecurity in the region.

item.title: Qatari PM FM to visit Tehran on Thursday
item.description: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesman Esmail Baqaei has announced that Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, Qatar’s Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, will visit Tehran on Thursday. According to Baqaei, the visit is part of ongoing Iran-Qatar consultations aimed at expanding bilateral relations and strengthening regional peace and security. Referring to Qatar’s good offices in recent months to help prevent further escalation in the region following the military aggression by the United States and the Israeli regime against Iran, Baqaei said the Qatari Prime Minister will hold discussions with Iranian officials on the continuation of Qatar’s mediation efforts and initiatives, as well as other regional developments.
